answer: Rotation is written down in the zenith index and the hollow audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 258 keys live and online for the whole period, thus the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the ocean beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. That is 35 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
